Explicit numeric issue footer: 511549239
The issue page was not fetched. The public commit message documents the defect:

[maglev] Disable maglev_gdbjit without gdbjit

Without ENABLE_GDB_JIT_INTERFACE or --gdbjit the maglev metadata
collection should be disabled.

Fixes performance regressions from uselessly recording the data.
Also fixes a SIGSEGV crash during non-eager inlining where the
direct recursion check relied on the debug-only graph labeller's
provenance mapping (which is null in release/non-tracing builds).
